test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On a circular race track of 2500 m, Sahil and Reena are running in the same direction at speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h, respectively. After how much time will they meet each other for the first time?
solution:
**Given:**

Circular race track length = 2500 m

Speed of Sahil = 27 km/h = (27 × 1000) / 3600 = 7.5 m/s

Speed of Reena = 45 km/h = (45 × 1000) / 3600 = 12.5 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to meet for the first time = Relative distance / Relative speed
